name: Xiao Qiao
title: The Unconventional Blossom

skills.name: Heavenly Scent
skills.text: Every instance you receive damage, you can discard an on-hand card with suit of hearts to transfer the damage to another player, then that player draws X cards (X being the units of health that player has lost thus far).

skills.name: Rosy Cheeks
skills.text: Your cards with the suit of spades are viewed as cards with the suit of hearts.

differenceFromNormal: Unfortunately, since she is Zhou Yu's wife, she also suffers hideous disfigurement of her portrait. Otherwise, she is unchanged.
